A Fayette County woman who had been reported missing in Morgantown has been found deceased.

Thirty-two-year-old Alexa Randolph was reported missing on Thursday.

Police say Randolph’s vehicle was found in the parking lot of the Walmart on Hornbeck Road. They found her body inside the cargo area of the vehicle.

The Monongalia County Sheriff’s Office is investigating her death as a homicide.

Anyone with information about her disappearance or death is asked to call the Monongalia County Sheriff’s Office Detectives at 304-291-7218.
groups.name: Alexa Randolph Case Discussion

Golf Clash University (GCU) is all about teaching each other about how Golf Clash works, how to get better, and how to analyze shots.

GCU stands out among a growing field of GC community pages because of our rules. They are important to us, they enable a learning environment, and they help ensure that over time we build up a body of SEARCHABLE posts that are readily available to future learners. We WILL remove posts that do not conform to the following:

For some of the posting no-nos in rule 6, we will set up specific posts devoted to those topics so you can just add to the comment section instead (such as friend requests and tournament open discussion). Check out the Announcements for links to these special posts.

Our rules are a lot to take in, and we do not expect perfection. We do not want to discourage anyone from posting, and a good rule of thumb is that if you have a genuine question, go ahead and post it. After all, by definition, it conforms with rule #1 because it has the purpose of gaining information!

Posts that violate the rules will be removed. People who repeatedly and knowingly violate the rules will be removed.
